description: Fill in src/routing/valhalla.js (buildValhallaRequest with exclude_locations, parseValhallaResponse decoding precision-6 shapes via geo.decodePolyline, ValhallaRouter with injected fetch, User-Agent, NoRouteError for Valhalla error_code 442/171, UpstreamError otherwise) and src/routing/stub.js (deterministic straight line or dog-leg per its JSDoc, using geo distances). Check the current Valhalla API docs for exclude_locations and note any surprise in a HUB ask. No network in tests. Unit tests in test/unit/routing.test.js; npm test must pass.
summary: ValhallaRouter (exclude_locations, precision-6 decoding, User-Agent, 442/171 to NoRouteError, everything else to UpstreamError) and the deterministic StubRouter are implemented, with 34 unit tests plus fixtures; all routing unit and acceptance tests pass. The only npm test failures are the 32 planner acceptance tests waiting on the planner task. Valhalla silently clamps exclude radius to 200 m, logged as critical routing.1.
title: Implement Valhalla and stub routers
